pages.title: Mature harvest
pages.text: Break a mature A, TFC or B crop with any tool. B replaces the default drop with a unified result:$(br2)$(li)seeds are returned;$(li)the crop product is retained;$(li)crop waste is added where the species defines it.$(br2)Immature crops do not drop products or seeds.

pages.title: Double crops
pages.text: For two-block crops, breaking either half clears the other half first. The same result is produced once, not twice.

pages.title: Creative mode
pages.text: In creative mode the block is removed without drops. Survival-only crop waste and seed return are not injected into the creative inventory.

pages.title: Crop waste
pages.text: Crop waste is a real byproduct, not a second seed. It is used as compost green or animal feed where supported.
